title: "Two distinct PDF paths" AC delivered as two payloads through the single demo path
detail: Spec AC says "watermark present on at least two distinct PDF paths". Both renders go through the identical pre-bake path — the demo's only PDF producer (per the PR survey). Documented deviation; intent (two distinct report shapes) is satisfied.
recommended_fix: None required — the survey proves only one demo path exists. Optionally rename the test to "two distinct demo reports" to avoid overstating path coverage.

title: Per-page watermark presence is guaranteed by template construction, not asserted by any test
detail: Rule 3 requires the watermark "on EVERY page". Presence tests compare whole-document bytes only; a future page style without the background would pass silently. Committed PDFs verified per-page today.
recommended_fix: In one presence test, count watermark op occurrences (e.g. the 40° rotation matrix) against the PDF page count and assert equality.
